drafter.private_reasoning: Open above the client's confidential minimum without disclosing it. Make the payment obligation definite and condition the release on receipt of cleared funds.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our proposed first draft. We have added a settlement amount, a payment deadline, and customary qualifications to the release and confidentiality provisions. We welcome your comments.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 16,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten business days after both parties sign this Agreement.

2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the matters described in the parties’ dispute through the date of this Agreement. This release does not affect either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law or reasonably necessary to obtain legal, tax, or financial advice or to enforce this Agreement. A party making a permitted disclosure shall, where practicable, request that the recipient maintain confidentiality.
